evd_title: LLMs designated expert-selected confounders in CDP as confounders at similar rates to variables trimmed from causal diagrams
finding: LLMs designated expert-selected confounders in CDP as confounders at similar rates to variables trimmed from causal diagrams
P: 172 candidate confounders (112 expert-considered + 60 non-confounders), Coronary Drug Project, causal inference/medicine
I: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o (temp 0.7, 10 calls), GPT-o1-preview (1 call); few-shot (3 worked examples), MCQ, direct/indirect prompts
C: Expert-curated confounder sets (CDPRG 1980, Murray & Hernan 2016, Debertin 2024) incl. trimmed and non-confounders
O: Direct, % at 100% confounder: trimmed 79/89/95% vs Added-in-2016 50/50/80% and Final DAG 69/76/71% (Claude/GPT-4o/o1)
T: Not reported; expert sets from CDPRG 1980, Murray & Hernan 2016, Debertin 2024 (paper 2024)
